source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-12 by column extension at fixed N: the start is CA(105; 2, 79, 7), the PCA product of Bose orthogonal arrays built by the R package CAs 0.24.4 (CAs:::labelToCode("pcaCA", 2, 79, 7)), plus one new column of random symbols (programs/start_105x80.txt); simulated annealing over the whole array at 105 rows (programs/casa.c, the project's tools/own_arrays/casa.c: casa 105 2 80 7 1 180 0.5 0.99995 out programs/start_105x80.txt) reached zero holes after 3.5 s. Exact check with ca_verify, all column pairs.
construction: Column extension at fixed N by simulated annealing, starting from the PCA product of Bose orthogonal arrays at 79 columns
notes: size equals the cited best known value (Direct product, Colbourn tables); first array the table can give for it
